relations.reading: Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.

relations.title: Comparación justa
relations.reading: The activation study should be assembled before outcomes are known, retaining failed reorganizations and absolute capability benchmarks rather than selecting only impressive survivors.

relations.title: Resultado upstream independiente
relations.reading: The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: The case-study framework can preserve the field observation as evidence while recording the migration interpretation as a separate, testable layer with its own data requirements.

relations.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
relations.reading: The historical Chicontepec account helps separate local capability formation from programme-level and territorial outcomes; improvement at one level cannot stand in for the others.
